From: Ravi Kapoor <ravi@nebulasys.ai>

Cc: procurement@nebulasys.ai
Date: 2026-10-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Dedicated capacity request: initial sizing for POC -> Prod

Evelyn —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. NebulaSys is targeting a POC next month that will transition to a small production deployment within ~90 days if performance and cost meet our KPIs. High level ask: we need a dedicated capacity footprint we can rely on for predictable latency during the POC and a short-term hold while we finalize commercial terms.

High level requirements (rough):
- Model: 70B/Inference-optimized (quantized) — peak context 4k tokens
- Expected concurrency: 30 active sessions, 300 token/sec aggregate
- Rough steady-state GPU equivalent: ~28 A100-80GB slots (inferred from our perf runs)
- Burst tolerance: +10% for 48hr launch spikes

Can Redwood provide:
1) A short-term capacity hold for late-stage deals (how long, terms) and what triggers release
2) A quick check of available dedicated GPU inventory in us-west region and fallback options (us-east/eu)
3) Approximate cost guidance for monthly reserved capacity vs. monthly committed usage for the above footprint

Procurement is looped for timing/PO questions. Attached is a draft mutual action plan (NEB-draft-MAP.pdf) — high level timeline included. Please let me know what you need from our side to lock a hold.

Best,
Ravi Kapoor
Head of ML Platforms | NebulaSys
Ravi.Kapoor@nebulasys.ai

Quick inventory/config check (summary) — attaching csv snapshot (capacity-snapshot-20261002.csv).

Short answer: We can cover a significant portion of NebulaSys's ask but not the full 28 A100-equivalent slots in a single us-west pool immediately without impacting other late-stage commitments. Details: 
- us-west-2 dedicated pool: 18x A100-80GB-equivalent slots immediately available (can be dedicated).
- us-east-1 standby pool: 12x available but requires cross-region routing and warm-up (estimated 12-24hr prep).
- Spot/burst in us-west (short-term standby): additional 10x GPUs possible but not SLA-backed; suitable for non-critical burst only.

Proposal (practical):
1) Offer a 14-day soft hold for 32 A100-equivalent slots across a mixed configuration: 18 dedicated in us-west + 8 in us-east (cross-region fallback) + 6 spot/burst for short spikes.
2) If NebulaSys signs an MSA and provides a 25% deposit for the committed portion (we recommend locking 26 of the 32 as guaranteed), we convert the 18 us-west + 8 us-east to guaranteed within 7 business days of deposit receipt.
3) If they do not commit within the 14-day hold, we release the non-guaranteed spot/burst slots; guaranteed slots are held only with deposit.

Operational caveats:
- Quantized 70B models reduce GPU memory footprint by ~20-30% depending on operator-level quantization; we will run a short compatibility test (2-3 runs) to firm up exact slot count.
- Cross-region routing adds ~10-25ms network latency — acceptable for many workloads but call this out to the customer.
- Autoscale policies: Dedicated pools have a 2-4hr vertical scale-up lead for cold-start of new nodes if not prewarmed. If NebulaSys needs zero warm-up, they must commit guaranteed capacity.

Next steps (I can own ops verification):
- Run two quick perf runs with their 70B quantized artifact (need container image + sample prompt set) — estimate 48hr.
- Confirm exact slot mapping and update pricing delta for dedicated vs. committed usage after tests.

Attaching capacity snapshot.

—Dev
Dev Patel
Lead, Capacity Planning | Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-10-05T15:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity request: initial sizing for POC -> Prod

Ravi —

Thanks for the clear ask and for the MAP you shared. We ran an ops inventory and sketched an executable hold path. High level commitment we can extend now: 

- Soft hold window: 14 calendar days from today (2026-10-05) to allow procurement + MSA review. During the soft hold we will reserve a mixed configuration of up to 32 A100-equivalent slots as described below.
- Guaranteed hold: 26 slots (18 in us-west-2 dedicated pool + 8 in us-east-1) can be converted to guaranteed within 7 business days of receiving a signed MSA and a 25% refundable deposit of the first month's committed amount.
- Burst capacity: up to 6 additional spot/burst slots can be reserved only during the soft hold; these are best-effort and will be released if not converted to guaranteed by the hold expiry.

Operational notes:
- We recommend you provide a quantized model build (container image + small prompt set) so our ops team can run a 48hr perf verification — this will narrow the slot counts and latency profile.
- Cross-region fallback (us-east) will add ~10-25ms RTT; if low single-digit ms SLOs are required, you should commit to all-guaranteed in a single region.

Commercial next steps (Marissa will follow up with formal hold terms):
- We will send a proforma deposit invoice once procurement confirms the short hold scope and the MSA draft is acceptable.
- If you want the hold extended beyond 14 days, we can discuss an extended hold with a larger deposit.

Marissa/Procurement: please send MSA draft comments and I'll loop legal if redlines are material. Marissa — please attach the proforma (we've prepared a standard proforma; see proforma-deposit-invoice.xlsx).

If that sounds good I can reply with a concise hold summary for your procurement team to sign off on.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
Evelyn.Hart@redwood.com
